svg.desc: A distributed GROUP BY: each input split is mapped and pre-aggregated by a combiner, the partial rows are shuffled to reducer hash(key) mod R, and each reducer merges the partials for its keys. The combiner cuts the shuffled rows from 2.4 million to about 15 thousand.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Map → shuffle → reduce, with a combiner

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: SELECT item_id, count(*), sum(clicked) … GROUP BY item_id on 4 machines.

svg.text: Combiners shrink algebraic aggregates (count, sum, avg); count(DISTINCT) and medians do not shrink.
